name: Dack's Duplicate
oracle_text: You may have this creature enter as a copy of any creature on the battlefield, except it has haste and dethrone. (Whenever it attacks the player with the most life or tied for most life, put a +1/+1 counter on it.)
blocked_sentences: You may have this creature enter as a copy of any creature on the battlefield, except it has haste and dethrone. (Whenever it attacks the player with the most life or tied for most life, put a +1/+1 counter on it.)

needs.what: an `except` on the `self_enters_as_copy` replacement that adds keywords (here haste and dethrone) to the copiable values the permanent enters with (707.9b), so the exception survives as part of the copy
needs.why_existing_wont_do: `self_enters_as_copy` takes only `copying` (the pool) and `zones.offer_enters_as_copy` records the chosen card id alone; `copy_permanent` and `become_copy` have exceptions but neither is a 614.1b replacement on the creature's own arrival, and a separate static granting haste and dethrone would not be part of the copiable values
